openings.claim: Changing concentrated left-corner loading to balanced removable clamps may reduce opposite-corner lift while controlling sliding; hatch/seal geometry may dominate instead. Use four strips, four bolts, four pads and tethered assemblies only if attachment feasibility resolves. Opposed lateral stops remain untested; no method winner.
openings.discriminator: Distribution predicts reduced opposite-corner lift after balancing; geometry dominance predicts persistent or relocated lift. Tighter retention may control sliding while worsening lift or reopening: coupled measurements decide acceptance. Equal bolt turns do not establish equal forces.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, check accessible rim geometry, strip span, safe padded contacts, recoverable tethers and unobstructed removal. If feasible within ninety fabrication minutes, screen left-biased placement with one ordinary and one right-card-disturbed closure/pull, then ten balanced opening/closure/pull cycles with final closure disturbed. Within twenty observation minutes, record marked displacement, corner heights, 20 N retention, reopening time, visible seal condition and maintenance using supplied tools. Twelve trials exhaust capacity, including disturbance per configuration; screening cannot validate the rival. Unsafe geometry or insufficient recording capacity means unresolved, with no outcome claims.
openings.uncertainty: Rim access, contact safety, strip stiffness and tether locations are unspecified; single-technician operation/recording capacity, force equality and causal attribution remain unknown. Acceptance is defeated by displacement beyond 1 mm, failed 20 N retention, reopening beyond 30 seconds, new seal tears, permanent deformation, lost components or blocked inspection. Do not drill, cut or glue hatch/trough; drill only supplied strips, retain hatch/rim/seal, use no powered mechanism, recover loose components, and leave the full marked opening clear when open. Final right-contact 1 mm card waives only seal-contact continuity.

lineage.reason: Retains pressure-versus-geometry relation, coupled acceptance, untested lateral-stop alternative, uncertain fit, feasibility checks, resource/stopping limits and defeat conditions.

decision: Feasibility first; select no winner. Order, unequal trial counts and unknown forces prevent causal proof; screening offers limited separation only. No deployment or cross-method consensus follows.
